gui.megatools.toggle.strip.desc: Axe: strip logs, scrape and un-wax copper (%s)
gui.megatools.toggle.path.desc: Shovel: make dirt paths, put out campfires (%s)
gui.megatools.toggle.till.desc: Hoe: till farmland. Sneak to till instead of making a path (%s)
gui.megatools.toggle.shear.desc: Shears: shear sheep, mooshrooms and snow golems, harvest leaves and vines, trim cave vines, kelp and weeping/twisting vines (%s)
gui.megatools.toggle.brush.desc: Brush: hold right click on suspicious sand or gravel (%s)
gui.megatools.toggle.ignite.desc: Flint and Steel: light fires, campfires, candles and TNT (%s)
message.megatools.plate_slot_empty: No enchantment plate in the %s slot
message.megatools.no_tool_selected: No stored tool matches this block
command.megatools.kit.success: Gave the Mega Tools kit to %s
tooltip.megatools.swapped: Carrying your %s - press %s to swap back
tooltip.megatools.plate.empty: Enchant it at an enchanting table, or combine it with an enchanted book in an anvil
tooltip.megatools.plate.usage: Place in a tool's plate slot (%s)
megatools.configuration.title: Mega Tools Config
megatools.configuration.menuStyle.toolti: Which tool menu you see: Classic (wide, buttons with text) or Compact (buttons with item icons). 'Ask next time' shows both the next time you open a tool menu. Your own choice; a server does not set it.
gui.megatools.menu_style.title: Choose your tool menu
gui.megatools.menu_style.classic.desc: Wide menu. Every button has its name written on it.
gui.megatools.menu_style.icons.desc: As wide as a chest. Every button is an item icon; hover a button to read what it does.
gui.megatools.menu_style.hint: Both menus do the same. You can change this at any time: Mods > Mega Tools > Config > Tool menu style.
megatools.configuration.heldLight.toolti: Whether a held tool with torches lights the area around the player. Set by the server; switching it off saves light updates on large servers.
message.megatools.contents_returned: The tool's stored items were returned to you
gui.megatools.toggle.delayed_break.desc: Mega Tool: short delay between block breaks while left click is held. Turn off to break as fast as you can aim (%s)
gui.megatools.quick_swap_hint: Press %s to swap to this tool
gui.megatools.light_slot: Torches (up to 256). Light up the area while you hold this tool; Place Torch uses them
message.megatools.tool_broken: This tool is broken - repair it in a crafting table
tooltip.megatools.broken: Broken: can't mine, attack or use abilities
tooltip.megatools.repair_hint: Repair: surround it with 8 %s in a crafting table
gui.megatools.toggle.place_torch.desc: Right click a block to place a torch from the torch slot (%s)
tooltip.megatools.support_tool: Shears, Brush and Flint and Steel in one
tooltip.megatools.support_tool.usage: Place in a paxel's or the Mega Tool's Support Tool slot (%s)
gui.megatools.support_slot: Support Tool: adds Shear, Brush and Ignite
gui.megatools.support_hint: Insert a Support Tool to unlock
gui.megatools.toggle.break.desc: Left click breaks blocks. Turn off and this tool breaks no blocks at all (%s)
gui.megatools.toggle.attack.desc: Left click hits mobs and players. Turn off and this tool does not hurt them; item frames, boats and the like can still be hit (%s)
gui.megatools.toggle.light.desc: Torch light: light up the area around you while holding this tool with torches in it (%s)
item.megatools.guide.tooltip: How to use paxels, the Mega Tool and their menus
gui.megatools.tool_stats_locked.title: Tool Stats are locked
gui.megatools.tool_stats_locked.no_world: Tool stats can only be changed from inside a world with cheats enabled, or as an operator of a world you host.
gui.megatools.tool_stats_locked.no_permi: Changing tool stats needs cheats enabled in this world, or operator permission.
gui.megatools.tool_stats_locked.server: On a server, the server's own tool stats are used. Server operators change them in the server's config/megatools-startup.toml and restart the server.
message.megatools.tool_stats_mismatch: Mega Tools: this server uses different tool stats than your game. Durability and mining may look wrong until your megatools-startup.toml matches the server's.
message.megatools.last_tool_gone: %s is no longer in tool storage
gui.megatools.swap_rules.open: Choose which blocks pre-select each stored tool
gui.megatools.swap_rules.whitelist.desc: Showing the whitelist: blocks that pre-select this tool. Click to show the blacklist
gui.megatools.swap_rules.blacklist.desc: Showing the blacklist: blocks this tool is never pre-selected for, unless a more exact whitelist filter matches. Click to show the whitelist
gui.megatools.swap_rules.no_tools: Put a tool in Tool Storage first
gui.megatools.swap_rules.copy.desc: Copy all custom rules of this tool, to paste them into another tool
gui.megatools.swap_rules.paste.desc: Replace all custom rules of this tool with the copied ones
gui.megatools.swap_rules.blacklisted: Blacklist: this tool is not pre-selected for
gui.megatools.swap_rules.empty_slot: Drop a block or a part (cable, P2P tunnel...) here from your inventory, JEI or EMI
gui.megatools.swap_rules.empty_slot.shif: Or Shift-click a block in your inventory
gui.megatools.swap_rules.not_a_block: A part, not a block: matches while you look at this part (cable, P2P tunnel...)
gui.megatools.swap_rules.hint.to_tag: Click: use for one of its tags
gui.megatools.swap_rules.hint.to_mod: Click: use for its whole mod
gui.megatools.swap_rules.hint.to_item: Click: use for this block only
